author: British Museum
title: British Museum catalogue record for photograph Oc-G-T-1536

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a lantern slide attributed to Katherine Maria Routledge, photographed in 1914–1915. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact. The museum's image page identifies this documentary representation, states image-specific CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms and supplies the required credit. The original JPEG was downloaded, visually reviewed against the catalogue description and preserved unchanged. The catalogue's complete Description identifies the quarry as Rano Raraku and describes the view; the longer curator's overview is not extracted. The former site-targeted extraction is retained here after correcting the collection boundary: “Lantern Slide (black and white) of a sliced image in three; view of the quarry of Rano Raraku; a fallen moai (figure carving) is lying on its face in the centre of the image, with a man and a horse standing beside it; Easter Island.” (Description) The site is not a collection object because its displacement is not under investigation.
